page: Amazon Web Services i7i.12xlarge is a storage-optimized server powered by an Intel Xeon 8559C processor built on the x86_64 architecture. This instance features 48 dedicated vCPUs (24 physical cores with hyper-threading) operating at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz, supported by a 320 MB L3 cache. It is equipped with 384.0 GB of high-speed DDR5 memory running at 6 GHz, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core. For local storage, the server includes 11250 GB of NVMe SSD capacity, alongside a baseline network bandwidth of 28 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate strong performance across memory operations and data processing. The system achieved a Passmark memory score of 2837.39 and a read-only small block memory bandwidth of 4099.27 GB/sec. In computational tasks, the server recorded a Geekbench single-core score of 2319.0 and a multi-core score of 20704.0, placing it in the top tier for image processing and multi-threaded decompression. Database operations are highly efficient, as evidenced by a Passmark database score of 26527.8 and a Redis SET throughput of 72.52 million operations per second.

Given its substantial local NVMe SSD capacity and high memory bandwidth, the i7i.12xlarge is highly cost-efficient for storage-intensive and memory-heavy workloads. It is particularly well-suited for large-scale databases, real-time analytics, and high-throughput web serving. While it lacks dedicated GPU hardware, its advanced vector and matrix extensions enable strong CPU-based LLM inference, processing 31.03 tokens per second on medium 7B models.
